name: Kurinnaxx
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/ruins-of-ahnqiraj/kurinnaxx.md. ESTIMATES: the Scarab Terrace is drawn as a 45 yd sandy circle with a southern approach (no map was measured); the fight is 150 s for a 100-30-0 split (research only says 2-4 min); Sand Trap cadence 10 s is the middle of the emulator 5-15 s, its warning 4.5 s is the middle of CMaNGOS 4 s and AzerothCore 5 s, its damage 2000 is the middle of 1750-2250 with an 8 yd radius; Wide Slash 1000 is the middle of the 800-1200 reported on a tank and its 14 yd cone is 10 yd past his hitbox; Thrash is the two extra swings folded into one 1300 front hit every 15 s (CMaNGOS 12-17 s); Mortal Wound every 9 s (middle of 8-10 s); melee 650 per 2 s so that his hits roughly double in Frenzy (enrageMultiplier 1.75, research says ~900 to ~2000); tank passive healing 650 per second stands for the 5-7 healers, so a tank who stands in Sand Traps or eats Thrash with no top-up still dies. ENGINE GAPS: Mortal Wound is a -10% healing per stack debuff and the tank swap at 3-4 stacks needs a second tank; neither is expressible, so Mortal Wound is modelled as a 15 s non-dispellable debuff whose 45 damage per second per application stands for the lost healing, and the swap is only described in the tips. Sand Trap's 20 s silence and -75% hit debuff on anyone caught cannot be applied by a hazard. Summon Player is not implemented (both emulators also skip it). The 'flying adds' Warcraft Tavern mentions are unconfirmed and left out. OPEN QUESTIONS carried from the research: Era HP, 30% vs 20% Frenzy threshold (30% used), whether Sand Trap targets a random player (used, plus a tank-targeted trap every 35 s for CMaNGOS' current-victim version), whether Frenzy can be Tranq-shotted.

labels.text: Open sand: tank him here, facing north

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Pull him to the open sand facing away from the raid, Taunt him back whenever a DPS pulls, walk him off every Sand Trap that lands under you, and live through Frenzy at 30%.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Stack on one flank, never in his 100 degree front (Wide Slash puts Mortal Wound on you), and step out of every sand ring before it bursts.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Spread so one Sand Trap catches one person, keep your threat under the tank's, step out of sand rings, burn with cooldowns at 30%.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Spread like ranged. The tank's healing taken drops 10% per Mortal Wound stack, so pre-cast before Thrash and Wide Slash and never let him sit under half, especially after Frenzy.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt the moment he turns on the raid. In the real fight this is also the swap button: the resting tank Taunts at 3-4 Mortal Wound stacks.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Keep it at 50-70% until Frenzy, then everything.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: Big heals on the tank. He takes 4000-5000 in a few seconds when Thrash and Wide Slash line up, and double that after Frenzy.

mortalWound.label: Mortal Wound
mortalWound.tip: -10% healing taken per stack for 15 s, refreshed on every application, not dispellable. Modelled here as 45 lost healing per second per application. Tanks swap at 3-4 stacks.

sandTrap.label: Sand Trap
sandTrap.tip: A sand ring grows under a random raider for about 4.5 s then bursts: 1750-2250 Nature in 8 yd plus a 20 s silence and -75% hit. Walk out before it bursts.

sandTrapTank.label: Sand Trap
sandTrapTank.tip: A sand ring under the tank. Walk him 10 yd without turning him toward the raid.

sandTrapOnYou.label: Sand Trap
sandTrapOnYou.tip: Drill version: the trap is always under you.

wideSlash.label: Wide Slash
wideSlash.tip: Weapon damage +500 to everything in a 10 yd arc in front of him, every 12-15 s. Anyone in it also picks up Mortal Wound.

thrash.label: Thrash
thrash.tip: Two extra swings on the tank every 12-17 s. With Wide Slash this is the spike window: 4000-5000 in a few seconds.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.toast: Kurinnaxx goes into a Frenzy: double tank damage
frenzy.tip: At 30%: +75% attack speed and +250 damage per hit until he dies. Tank cooldowns, healers spam, DPS burn.

aggroPull.label: Aggro pull
aggroPull.tip: A DPS overtakes the tank on threat.

expectations.label: Pull him to the open sand, facing north
expectations.tip: Pull deliberately, his aggro range is huge. Walk him north past the raid and turn so his front points at open sand, never at the raid.

expectations.label: Keep his front off the raid
expectations.tip: Wide Slash hits a 10 yd arc in front of him and anyone in it gets Mortal Wound. Face him away, and never turn him toward the raid during a swap.

expectations.label: Taunt him back when a DPS pulls
expectations.tip: Someone will pull. The moment he turns, Taunt: every second he faces the raid is a Wide Slash and a Mortal Wound on a rogue.

expectations.label: Walk him off Sand Traps
expectations.tip: A ring under you means move him 10 yd, keeping him faced away. Do not stand in it with him.

expectations.label: Stay out of his front
expectations.tip: Melee stack on one flank or behind. Nobody but the active tank stands in the 10 yd arc in front of him.

expectations.label: Step out of sand rings before they burst
expectations.tip: The ring grows for about 4.5 s. Leave the 8 yd circle. If you are caught: 2000 damage, 20 s silence, wand or bandage.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro
expectations.tip: Red band means stop. 50-70% output until Frenzy.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Thrash plus Wide Slash is 4000-5000 in a few seconds, and every Mortal Wound stack cuts your heals by 10%. Pre-cast and keep him above half.

expectations.label: Keep his front off the raid
expectations.tip: He hits twice as hard now. Hold him still, cooldowns up, front at the sand.

expectations.label: Walk him off Sand Traps
expectations.tip: Even in Frenzy a ring under you means move him 10 yd.

expectations.label: Stay out of his front
expectations.tip: Burn from the flank, never the front.

expectations.label: Step out of sand rings before they burst
expectations.tip: A silenced healer during Frenzy kills the tank. Keep moving out of rings.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro
expectations.tip: Use every cooldown, but a pull in Frenzy is a dead rogue.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive through Frenzy
expectations.tip: His hits roughly double. Chain big heals, everyone on the tank.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

playerInHazard.label: Caught in a Sand Trap
playerInHazard.tip: Leave the ring before it bursts.

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red one more hit pulls him.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top him up before Thrash, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Mana you waste now is mana you need in Frenzy.

cues.notes: Press notes in the lane above the ability bar.

list.label: Taunt when he turns on the raid
list.tip: The moment he turns, Taunt. A Wide Slash into the raid is a Mortal Wound on a DPS.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with Thrash coming is where tanks die, and Mortal Wound makes every heal smaller. Heal now.

drills.name: Pull and Sand Traps
drills.description: Pull him from the approach to the open sand, then walk him off three Sand Traps that land under you without turning him toward the raid.

drills.name: Taunt him back
drills.description: Already tanking. DPS keep pulling aggro; Taunt him back the instant he turns, never before.

drills.name: Sand Trap footwork
drills.description: Already on him. A Sand Trap grows under you every 12 s: step out of the ring every time, then get straight back to attacking from the flank.

drills.name: Healing through Frenzy
drills.description: He is at 30% and frenzied. Keep the tank above half through Thrash and Wide Slash with Mortal Wound shrinking your heals; wasted heals count against you.
